fusions.name: Nailed in Place
fusions.desc: You stamp on the target's foot for 14 damage, stunning it for 0.8 seconds. It is [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Circling Trot
fusions.desc: You trot a tight circle, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Round-Up
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Nowhere to Bolt
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
